head: 1fae37085610e1be5e9305ed38b4dc0ee47f22cf
title: fix(progress): weights show, check-ins save, coach weight trend reads forward (AUDIT-06-125, T4)
body:
**Tier:** T4 (client health data: weight logs and daily check-ins; coach view of a client's progress). Mobile only.
**Why:** AUDIT-06-125 (agent 125, owner 13:50 10-06 "audit every single one of these areas, seperately, in depth"). Three normal-day Bs in Progress: weights never show, check-ins never save, the coach reads every weight trend backwards.
**T4 trigger scan:** health data read/write paths only. No auth, tenancy, RLS, money, credentials or destructive-data change. Payload change only removes two keys the server already rejects. No new endpoint, no new flag, no dependency, no migration.
**T3 trigger scan:** shared parser moved from ProgressScreen.tsx into `screens/client/progress/weightHistory.ts` (re-exported from ProgressScreen, so no import breaks). No navigation, store or API client behaviour change beyond the type of the check-in body.
**Bounded T1:** copy and unit label on the coach Progress tab.
**Canonical builder:** AUDIT-06-125 (Claude Opus 5.5).
**Acceptance evidence:** new tests below fail on main; PR CI (jest + tsc + lint) is the proof. Works against the CURRENT production backend (ec12a4b3): it reads the body production already sends and sends only keys production already accepts.

## Fixes
- **B1** A client logs a weight, returns to Progress and still sees "Log your weight to see your chart", "--" for Start/Current and no entries: GET /weight/history answers `{ logs, height_cm }` and the screen only read a bare array. Now reads `logs` (bare array still accepted). The existing chart test mocked an array; it now mocks the real body.
- **B2** A client fills in Habits & Check-in and taps Save Check-in: every save fails with a 400 and the coach never gets a check-in, because the app sent `sleep_quality` and `stress` and the server DTO rejects unknown keys (`forbidNonWhitelisted`). The body is now built by `buildCheckInPayload` with only DTO keys; the Quality stars and Stress card, which production cannot store, are removed from the form.
- **B3** A coach opens a client's Progress tab and sees the newest weight as "First", the oldest as "Latest" and the change with the wrong sign (down 10 lb read +10.0 in warning colour), because the summary sends weight_logs newest first. The tab now orders by day; the list stays newest first; each entry shows "lbs".
- **U1** My Report weekly weights showed a raw ISO date, a blank weight and "--" for Current (rows carry `weight_lbs`, the screen read `weight`). Now uses the Progress parser.
- **U2** Coach client Timeline: every check-in read "Mood: undefined/5" with "Invalid Date" (`mood_rating` is not a field; a time was appended to an ISO string), every workout read "Workout". Now real mood/energy/sleep, a valid date, and `workout_name`.
- **U3** Progress entries showed the day before the logged day for US clients (the date-only column arrives as UTC midnight and was bucketed to local time). Now keeps the calendar day.

## Tests (fail on main)
- `src/screens/client/progress/__tests__/weightHistory.test.ts` (B1, U3)
- `src/screens/client/__tests__/ProgressScreen.chart.test.tsx` default mock = real server body (B1)
- `src/screens/client/habits/__tests__/checkInPayload.test.ts` (B2)
- `src/screens/coach/client-detail/__tests__/ProgressTab.test.tsx` (B3)
- `src/screens/coach/client-detail/__tests__/checkInSubtitle.test.ts` (U2)

## Overlap
None of the open agent 124 PRs touch these files. m#408 (Clients list "N to review" badge) depends on coach check-in review, which no app screen calls yet (reported to the operator, not in this PR).

Size: 431 changed lines (294 + / 137 -), tests included.
